snippet_primary: "It was initially good, but I cancelled my account. Impossible to get these people to stop taking my money. Be VERY careful here and if you signup and cancel be willing to go through the process of canceling your credit card afterwards. I cancelled my membership around one year ago. And since then Ive been trying to get them to stop taking money. So even though I give them my full name and they are able to cancel my account to block me from seeing more videos they are apparently NOT able to cancel my payments and keep taking and taking and taking and taking my money from my card via applepay - of course its only 6.50€ per month, but what do I have to do to get them to stop? Cancel my debit card"
